definition: a ceremonial procession of people marching
description: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

en.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?
